description: com.apple.webarchive from the macOS general pasteboard
how: Opened file:///private/tmp/rclip-capture/page.html (h1, a paragraph with bold/italic and a link, a 3-row bordered table), used the Find bar to move focus into the page, then Edit > Select All, Edit > Copy.
notes: A bplist00 binary plist holding the main resource's bytes, MIME type, text encoding and source URL (file:///private/tmp/rclip-capture/page.html - a throwaway file, not a real document).
